examples.solution_text:
The angle opposite $\angle ABC$ is $\angle CDA$.

Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary.

$\begin{align*}\angle BCD&=180^{\circ}-104^{\circ}\\\angle BCD&=76^{\circ}\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\angle CDA&=180^{\circ}-82^{\circ}\\\angle CDA&=98^{\circ}\end{align*}$

Check: $104^{\circ}+82^{\circ}+76^{\circ}+98^{\circ}=360^{\circ}$.

The exterior angle at $C$ equals the opposite interior angle at $A$.

$\begin{align*}\angle DAB&=\angle DCE\\\angle DAB&=100^{\circ}\end{align*}$

The adjacent interior angle and exterior angle lie on the straight line $BCE$.

$\begin{align*}\angle BCD+100^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\\angle BCD&=80^{\circ}\end{align*}$

Each exterior angle equals the opposite interior angle.

$\begin{align*}\angle BCD&=\angle BAE\\\angle BCD&=78^{\circ}\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\angle ABC&=\angle ADF\\\angle ABC&=84^{\circ}\end{align*}$

Opposite interior angles are supplementary.

$\begin{align*}\angle DAB&=180^{\circ}-78^{\circ}\\\angle DAB&=102^{\circ}\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\angle CDA&=180^{\circ}-84^{\circ}\\\angle CDA&=96^{\circ}\end{align*}$

Check: $102^{\circ}+84^{\circ}+78^{\circ}+96^{\circ}=360^{\circ}$.

Let $\angle LKT=x$.

Angles on the straight line $NKT$ are supplementary.

$\angle LKN=180^{\circ}-x$.

Opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral $KLMN$ are supplementary.

$\begin{align*}\angle LMN+\angle LKN&=180^{\circ}\\\angle LMN+(180^{\circ}-x)&=180^{\circ}\\\angle LMN&=x\end{align*}$

Therefore $\angle LKT=\angle LMN$.

Exterior-angle equality gives C = 78° and B = 84°. Supplementary opposite angles give A = 102° and D = 96°; the total is 360°. The coordinates reproduce all four angles, with E beyond A on DA and F beyond D on CD.
